dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical and gradual narrowing of the 2D profile from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to mature white baseline with subtle shading along the lateral margins.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, thin, linear marks consistent with shallow epidermal scratches or rake marks across the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring and scratches on the dorsal and lateral-dorsal surfaces.
